title: Nutty Indulgent Mexican Pork Cochinita Pibil
description: This dish is a floral and springy Mexican recipe featuring desiccated coconut and air-fried pork, making it a macrobiotic-friendly and indulgent meal option.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine desiccated coconut, roasted poblano peppers, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, lime juice, and olive oil to make a marinade.
Place the pork shoulder in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it, making sure the pork is fully coated.
Let the pork marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it in the air fryer basket.
Cook the pork in the air fryer for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced pork with additional desiccated coconut and roasted poblano peppers on top, if desired.
